frame_mapping.reason: Official inference truncates exo and prior to first num_frames=49; official GT/prior preprocessing also selects first 49 without even downsampling.

output_region_expected.reason: Official pipeline decodes exo and ego latents separately and concatenates exo left / ego right.

native_plane_evidence: Official datasets/utils.py preprocess_video_with_resize ego_gt/ego_prior uses width=height and no rotation/flip; provided GT already 448 square.
Official sft_trainer.py lines 672-688 decode latent_ego to 448x448 and concatenate as right branch without rotation/flip.
GT and prior preview confirms upright supplied image convention; this is a raster convention check, not ray-level calibration.
calibration_limits: No source-specific online_calibration or original sensor timestamp provenance bundled with the selected EgoX example.
Provided ego K has fx=fy=150 and cx=cy=255.5, whereas the 448x448 raster midpoint is 223.5; no independently verified preprocessing mapping is provided.
Official infer.py uses hardcoded Aria distortion coefficients and rotates ray maps; these official conditioning settings are preserved unchanged.
alignment_review.allowed_metric_scope: Descriptive full-raster RGB reconstruction error against the official supplied GT, conditional on completed real-output shape/hash review; not a sensor-calibrated camera-pose metric.
alignment_review.review_method: Checked original successful run: 49 decoded frames, 1232x448, 30fps; reviewed GT versus generated native right branch at frames 0,4,8,...,48. Both use upright supplied fisheye raster with consistent left/right scene orientation. Position differences are retained as model errors; no registration was performed.
summary_zh: 已核对真实输出尺寸、右侧分支、画面方向和源帧编号；按官方原生 448×448 平面直接比较。
生成中的球、人和相机视野与 GT 存在偏差，保留这些误差，不做后验配准。
原始传感器标定和采集时间未独立验证；指标仅描述该交付图像平面，不代表标定精度。

comparison_domain: Decoded official GT RGB uint8 versus rightmost 448 columns of unmodified official output; full 448x448 including black fisheye border
transformations: No scaling, rotation, translation, warping, masking, colour correction, temporal shift or best-match search. Select source frames 0..48 per official truncation; extract generated branch x=784..1231.
decoder: OpenCV 5.0.0 BGR to RGB; metrics before extra delivery encode
aggregation: Arithmetic mean across 49 per-frame PSNR and SSIM values; PSNR uses 8-bit RGB MSE. SSIM Gaussian sigma=1.5, population covariance, per-channel average.
scope: Descriptive error in supplied benchmark raster; not a calibration validation or reproduction of paper aggregate results.
lpips: Not computed; PSNR and SSIM suffice for this basic evaluation. No additional metric model downloaded.
temporal_note: Adjacent-frame MAE includes camera/object motion and must not be called a flicker metric.
observations_zh: 场景与视角：球门、黄色标志盘、红衣球员和向下看脚部再抬头的变化能够生成；草地明显更平滑、偏蓝，视野和人物尺度与 GT 不完全一致。
球的位置：0–16 帧可见脚前足球；20–48 帧 GT 中球逐渐到达对方脚下，生成中球仍偏近、滞留在前景，传递距离和接球关系没有准确复现。
人和遮挡：0–18 帧生成了较大面积的红色躯干、手臂和鞋，肢体轮廓与 GT 不同；脚与球接触附近存在形变。28–48 帧对方球员的脚部与手臂动作明显弱于 GT，不能据此验证真实接触或遮挡关系。
连续性与闪烁：49 帧均不同，场地和球门大体连续，缩略逐帧检查未见整屏突闪；局部球纹、手脚形状仍有变化。相邻帧 MAE 包含真实运动，未将其冒充独立闪烁指标。

visual_review.method: 49-frame labeled contact sheet, native-size GT/generated pairs, browser frame stepping and 0.25x playback functionality check; no frame or seed selection.
